# hella.rich

## Summary

hella.rich is an AI-native experimental product lab by Jeffrey Willis / Dicanomi.

It contains small interactive web products exploring sound, motion, emotional UX, humor, browser-native audio, strange utilities, and rapid AI-assisted product creation.

## Creator

Created and directed by Jeffrey Willis, operating as Dicanomi.

- Site: https://hella.rich/
- GitHub: https://github.com/dicanomi

## Canonical Description

hella.rich is an AI-native experimental product lab by Jeffrey Willis / Dicanomi, featuring small interactive web products built around sound, motion, emotional UX, browser DSP, strange utilities, and playful internet experiences.

## Products

- **HELLA•4** — A reel recorder for field takes, cue loops, and tape-touching trouble. URL: https://hella.rich/deck
- **HAPPY HUMAN** — A labor archive for jobs that were already politely deleted. URL: https://hella.rich/happy-human
- **HELLA.FM** — Preprogrammed local frequencies for the end of normal radio. URL: https://hella.rich/hella.fm/
- **HELLA_RADIO** — A late-night signal you tune into. URL: https://hella.rich/radio
- **HELLA.SYNTH** — A browser-native instrument with a hand-written audio engine. URL: https://hella.rich/synth
- **THE_MACHINE.EXE** — The market is the setting. Human psychology is the subject. URL: https://hella.rich/machine-exe
- **HUMAN.EXE** — A biological diagnostic machine that discovers more than it was designed to find. URL: https://hella.rich/human-exe
- **ORB** — A living interactive object. Emotional states expressed through color, sound, and motion. URL: https://hella.rich/orb
- **DEAD AIR** — Late-night radio scanner. Analog transmissions from the void. URL: https://hella.rich/dead-air
- **ÆTHER** — Ambient sound synthesizer. Impossible to sound bad. URL: https://hella.rich/aether
- **SPACE DRONE** — A drifting machine for doing absolutely nothing. URL: https://hella.rich/space-drone
- **LOW BATTERY** — The sound you ignore until it becomes your personality. URL: https://hella.rich/low-battery
- **FOURCAST** — A weather app predicting the end of the world. Politely. URL: https://hella.rich/fourcast
- **THE EYE** — A strange object that notices you. URL: https://hella.rich/the-eye

## Stack And Production Tools

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript, TSX, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS v4, custom CSS, Radix UI primitives, lucide-react, wouter routing.
- Build and deployment: Vite, pnpm, Node.js, esbuild, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Pages Functions, Wrangler checks.
- Design and motion: Figma, Framer Motion, GSAP motion thinking, CSS clamp() responsive sizing, Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Canvas 2D, SVG, GLB, PNG, WebP, custom fonts.
- Audio: Tone.js, Web Audio API, browser DSP, oscillators, filters, envelopes, LFO modulation, FFT/waveform analysers, compression, limiting, waveshaping, delay, reverb, chorus, distortion, bitcrushing, 8-bit computer sound, arcade tones, drones, warning beeps, radio static, and MP3 station libraries.
- Production support: Python, shell/CLI workflows, manual visual QA, responsive checks, route checks, build verification, cache-busted live verification, and rollback-safe commits.
- AI and creative tools: OpenAI GPT / Codex, Manus, Kimi, Claude, Gemini, Higgsfield, Midjourney, GPT Image, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Nano Banana, and Suno.

## What It Demonstrates

- AI-native product development and rapid prototyping.
- Interaction design and emotional UX.
- Browser-native audio, sound design, and DSP.
- Motion design, WebGL, Canvas, and Three.js visual systems.
- Creative technology and experimental web experiences.
- Human creative direction with AI-assisted production.
